broll: Opening shot (reused as the loop shot at the end): close-up of a hand reaching for a cream jar, slow push-in, shallow focus. Use the HOKAR clip of a man holding up a jar, or film a generic unbranded jar yourself.
Phone screen scrolling a social feed; every face and brand on the screen is blurred.
cards.sfx: Low sub-bass hit on frame 1; soft tick as each line appears.

broll: HOKAR reel: the presenter speaking into a microphone on an Erbil street at night. Original audio muted.
cards.sfx: Short reverse-cymbal swell into the card.

broll: HOKAR clip: men holding up jars of the cream. Slow push-in on one jar; darken the background so the number reads.
cards.sfx: A single dull impact on the number line. No cartoon or cash-register sounds.

lines: û etîketa wî jî sexte ye
broll: Wide night shot of an Erbil street (own footage or HOKAR background).
Close-up of a jar label from the HOKAR clip; do not add any 'FAKE' stamp or red X: the claim is unconfirmed.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash before this card.

broll: HOKAR clips of the advertisers holding the jars. No zooms, freeze-frames or mocking effects on faces; keep it respectful.
cards.sfx: Music drops to the pulse only for this card.

broll: Generic laboratory glassware or a courthouse exterior, marked 'illustrative' in small text (see labels.illustrative).
cards.sfx: Hold the music steady; no hit. This card must feel calm and factual.

broll: Kurdistan24 reel: market stalls, uniformed security officers, shelves of cosmetics and supplements.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash before this card; light street ambience under the music.

broll: Kurdistan24 reel: the speaker holding up the pink bottle of whitening pills.
cards.sfx: Music ducks 4 dB under this card.

broll: Kurdistan24: open market stall with medicine and supplements.
Contrast cut: a licensed pharmacy counter (own footage), green cross sign.
cards.sfx: Hard cut on the beat between the stall and the pharmacy.

broll: Macro close-up of a product sticker on a box (Kurdistan24 footage or a generic box you film; blur any real brand).
cards.sfx: Single soft impact on 'does not mean'.

broll: Fakhir Hariri's own clarification video, speaking to camera. Use it unaltered: no slow-motion, filters, zooms or sound effects on him.
cards.sfx: Music drops to a low drone; no hits during his two cards (fairness).

broll: Continue the same Hariri clip; one cut to a second moment of the same video.
cards.sfx: Low drone continues.

broll: Screen capture of the official Arabic law text (UN ESCWA PDF), slow scroll, with the definition of 'advertiser' (Article 1) softly highlighted.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash; music starts its slow build here.

broll: Law PDF: Article 7 highlighted line by line in sync with the words.
cards.sfx: Soft tick per line.

broll: Law PDF: Article 9 highlighted.
cards.sfx: Soft tick per line.

broll: Dark, slow push-in on a judge's gavel or an empty courtroom (stock), marked 'illustrative'.
cards.sfx: Deep impact on the prison line; music peaks here.

broll: Macro, own footage: a sticker slowly peeled off a plain, unbranded jar. Black-and-white grade.
cards.sfx: White flash + boom, then near-silence: one low piano note.

broll: Dwin dark-green background; behind it, very blurred, a phone showing a like counter rising.
cards.sfx: Firm low string swell.

lines: bi reklamên bê kontrol xelkê dixapînin
broll: Same Dwin background, Dwin logo watermark centred at 8% opacity behind the text.
cards.sfx: Strings hold; one deep hit on the last word, then music turns to the hopeful cue.

broll: Own footage: a pharmacist handing a boxed medicine across the counter; warm, bright grade.
cards.sfx: Whoosh on the white flash; hopeful piano + light percussion starts.

broll: A thumb scrolling past a generic ad on a phone (mock ad with an invented product; no real person).
cards.sfx: Soft swipe sound on the scroll.

broll: Own footage: hands photographing a receipt and a product box with a phone.
cards.sfx: Camera-shutter click synced to the phone tap.

lines: gilî bike li ba rayedarên tenduristiyê
broll: Exterior of a health directorate building (own footage) or a hand filling in a complaint form.
cards.sfx: Music lifts slightly.

broll: Return to the opening shot (hand reaching for the jar), the hand stops and pulls back. Ends on the exact first frame of C01 so the reel loops.
cards.sfx: Music resolves on the final chord; hard stop on the last frame.

broll: Dwin dark-green end background.
cards.sfx: Silence or the last chord's tail.

lines: Dengê Kurdan, bi nasname û baweriya me
broll: Dwin logo animates in (scale 96% → 100%, 0.4 s), dark-green background, gold shield.
cards.sfx: Dwin sound logo if you have one; otherwise silence.

post_caption:
Gelo reklama kesekî navdar bes e ku tu baweriyê bi hilberekê bînî?
Vîdyoyeke belavbûyî dibêje kremê «Almas» sexte ye, û Faxir Herîrî dibêje etîket ne pirsgirêka wî ye. Qanûna Parastina Xerîdar a Iraqê (hejmar 1, 2010) reklamkeran jî berpirsiyar dike.
Derman tenê ji dermanxaneyên destûrdar bikire.
Dwîn - Dengê Kurdan, bi nasname û baweriya me
